test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

She has checked everything she needs __before started work__.
solution:
The correct answer is **"before starting work"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's see the correct formation of the sentence:

__
 
• She has checked everything she needs ***before starting work .​***

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Here we will see the formation:

 
• **before starting work - ***Before *as a conjunction

 
We commonly use before with the past simple tense. It suggests that the second event happened soon after the first one.
